violations.text:
Employee personal items stored in or above a food preparation area, food, clean equipment and utensils, or single-service items.
Cell phone on cutting board

No handwashing sign provided at a hand sink used by food employees.
Prep area operator posted sign

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
Sliced ham 51f above chill line. In service 1 hour. Operator moved to bottom to chill

Food-contact surface soiled with food debris, mold-like substance or slime.
Ice bin walls
No handwashing sign provided at a hand sink used by food employees.

Plumbing system in disrepair.
Pvc leaking under 3 bay sink

Single-use gloves not changed as needed after changing tasks or when damaged or soiled.
Employee handled raw shelled eggs and handled cheese. Provided education. Employee washed handles and changed gloves

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
sausage patties (52F - Cold Holding) 2nd temp 43f.
In cooler for 3 hours. Advised to rapid chill
salmon (44F - Cold Holding); cream cheese (44F - Cold Holding)
Observed large gaps between containers in cooler.

Time/temperature control for safety food identified in the written procedure as a food held using time as a public health control has no time marking and the time removed from temperature control cannot be determined. Butter

No proof provided that food employees are informed of their responsibility to report to the person in charge information about their health and activities related to foodborne illnesses.
New hires, emailed to operator

Nonfood-contact surface soiled with grease, food debris, dirt, slime or dust.
Gaskets soiled on on reach in freezer

Food-contact surface soiled with food debris, mold-like substance or slime.
Slicer blade has old food debris. Advised manager to clean
